_doc: REPORTED published numbers (transcribed from the primary papers). Provenance labels, NOT our toy. Each `cite` is a data/papers.json id.
_source: Vaswani 2017, Devlin 2019, Sanh 2019, Liu 2019, Lan 2020, Clark 2020, Raffel 2020, Lewis 2020, Radford 2019, Brown 2020, Dao 2022 — see data/papers.json

transformer._doc: Attention Is All You Need — the base Transformer (enc-dec).

distilbert._doc: DistilBERT: ~40% smaller, ~60% faster, retains ~97% of BERT's GLUE score.

gpt3._doc: GPT-3: 175B parameters, 2048-token context; in-context few-shot learning.

variants._doc: BERT-family training-objective variants (facts, not our computation).

roberta._note: no NSP, dynamic masking, more data/compute

efficientAttention._doc: FlashAttention: exact attention in O(n) memory (no materialized n×n matrix).
